Rows from the UCDP 26.1 CSV downloads (https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/), cut to the years 2021-2025 and to
rows that name Ukraine, Russia, Myanmar, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Nigeria, Israel or Syria. The rows are
unchanged. Used only by tests/ucdpConflict.test.ts.

Source: UCDP, Uppsala University, licensed CC BY 4.0. Davies, Pettersson & Öberg (2026), "Organized
violence 1989-2025", Journal of Peace Research; Gleditsch et al. (2002), Journal of Peace Research 39(5).
